title: Quadratic homogeneous noncommutative lower bounds for ordered symmetric polynomials

core_obligations: Control the simultaneous derivatives of weighted-homogeneous circuits.

difficulty_reason: Develops a weighted-homogeneous partial-derivative argument and interval restrictions for ordered symmetric polynomials, obtaining the quadratic circuit lower bound. Homogeneity, variable/degree range and the distinction from nonhomogeneous upper bounds remain explicit.
